use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

evidence_cards.content: A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This condition acts as a trigger for the C2 JU to assume R² of an IU and report it, which constitutes the start of the defined reporting process.

evidence_cards.content: A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specific message state acts as a trigger for the C2 JU to initiate the reporting action.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Receiving this specific external message triggers the C2 JU to assume responsibility and report the unit.

evidence_cards.content: The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This data quality threshold serves as a trigger condition for the C2 JU to change the status and report the unit.

evidence_cards.content: A JU transmits a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request to initiate the immediate transmission of a specific point, line, or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This action serves as the trigger for the use case 'Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas' by initiating the reporting process.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific event that initiates the process described in the text.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific action (setting the FT IND) that triggers the alert initiation process for reference points and areas.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R2 for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific triggering event (receipt of J7.1 message) that initiates the response behavior in the use case context.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides for the description of segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific geometric entities (areas and lines) that the system can report as a result of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: Each point, line, or area reported on the interface shall be assigned a TN(s) by the reporting JU, and the position shall be reported using geodetic latitude/longitude values.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.3.1 POINT, LINE, AND AREA REPORTING, first paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the mandatory state of the data objects (assigned Track Number and coordinate format) after successful reporting.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the immediate observable system state change in receiving units after a successful update of geometric data, which constitutes a postcondition for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) point, line, or area retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point, line, or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state of Reporting Responsibility (R²) retention by the originator after successful reporting.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may assume R² for the point, line, or area using the same Reference TN(s).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the postcondition where R² status changes due to inactivity or termination messages.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides for the description of segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific geometric area types supported by the system, which is a fundamental condition for the use case 'Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas'.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) point, line, or area retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point, line, or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the system state regarding Reporting Responsibility (R²) retention which must hold before a new unit can assume responsibility via the trigger.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a mandatory state condition — correlation of local sensor data by the C² JU — that must hold before the system can proceed to report inactive/limited status IUs as tracks or points on the Surveillance Network PG. This is a direct precondition for initiating reporting behavior under this use case context.

evidence_cards.content: The designated reference point from which Delta Latitude 1, Delta Longitude 1, Delta Latitude 2, and Delta Longitude 2 are measured is that given by the Latitude and Longitude fields in the J3.0E0 word.

evidence_cards.content: Certain reference points and areas may be slaved in a constant position in relation to a Related TN.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU ceases reporting a point, line, or area for which it had reporting responsibility, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have R² for the Reference TN before it can respond to a J7.1 message with Data Update Request Action field set to value 2.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² may transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request to initiate immediate transmission of a specific point, line, or area without awaiting the next periodic update.

evidence_cards.content: After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, C² JUs capable of assuming R² for air, surface, or land tracks shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a system state condition (Active status achieved/returned) and mandatory pre-transmission checks that must hold before the JU can report tracks — directly relevant to preconditions for defining reference points/geometric areas which involve track transmission.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² for a line or area shall transmit the entire line or area upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) for any TN used to define the line or area.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 Reference Point, J3.1 Emergency Point, and the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track messages are used to report points, e.g., waypoints, downed aircraft, SAM sites, etc.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the purpose of the message types involved in defining reference points and geometric areas, which directly corresponds to the goal of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits data concerning points comprising a segmented line or multisided area to prevent confusion and possible misunderstanding.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the primary objective of the use case: to define reference points and geometric areas by transmitting their data to ensure clarity for receiving units.

evidence_cards.content: The objective is to allow a JU without reporting responsibility (R²) to request and receive the immediate transmission of a specific point, line, or area by transmitting a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement explicitly defines the goal of the actor (JU without R²) in initiating the interaction described in the use case context.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits J3.0 messages to report points, lines, or areas with appropriate Time Function values set.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 Reference Point message is used to report the actual or expected Impact Point of a ballistic missile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Directly states the objective (goal) of using the J3.0 message for reporting impact points, which is part of defining reference points and geometric areas in the context of ballistic missile tracking.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU initiates a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary actor's objective for this use case: initiating an alert on geometric entities via specific message fields.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R² for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.

evidence_cards.content: NonC2 JUs shall not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.

evidence_cards.content: If no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals for an emergency point, another JU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.0 message with FT IND set to value 0.

evidence_cards.content: When defining an area that is a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, a J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C2, J3.5I/J3.5E0/J3.5C3, or a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence is used.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific message sequences required for different geometric shapes in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the initial word shall be set to value 2, Line, when describing a segmented line and shall be set to value 3, Multi-point Area, when describing a multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the configuration parameters necessary to distinguish between line and area definitions during transmission.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits a J3.0 message to define the reference point or geometric area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action in the main flow for defining points/areas.

evidence_cards.content: If IFF/SIF data is available, it is transmitted in the J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI = 0) messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the transmission of additional data types within the main flow sequence.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary actor's action to initiate an alert as part of the normal interaction sequence for defining reference points/areas with alert status.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert upon receipt of the J3.0 message with FT IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system response from receiving units, completing the main flow interaction for alert initiation.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall terminate a force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message terminating the alert and setting the FT IND in subsequent J3.0 messages to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the termination step in the main flow for clearing alerts on reference points/lines/areas.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall terminate the alert upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system response for alert termination, completing the main flow interaction.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R² shall respond with surveillance information upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary response action for the main flow when a data update request is received.

evidence_cards.content: This JU shall transmit all data held in the appropriate J3 message, except that covariance data will not be included on ballistic missile tracks.

source_locations.location: Top of page 109, continuing from section 4.7.2.1.1

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the content of the response message transmitted by the C2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² for a line or area shall transmit the entire line or area upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) for any TN used to define the line or area.

source_locations.location: Top of page 109, end of first paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies the scope of data transmission for geometric areas and lines.

evidence_cards.content: When the J3.0 message is used to report a point, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field shall be set to value 0, Point, in the initial word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative flow where the J3.0 message defines a single point (Descriptor = 0) rather than a line or area, which diverges from the main flow of defining multisided areas.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency points are transmitted as J3.1 messages and may be related to a previously reported track/point by including the TN, Previously Reported as amplifying information.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This represents an alternative flow using a different message type (J3.1) for specific emergency conditions, diverging from the standard J3.0 reporting.

evidence_cards.content: When joining three or more points to form a segmented line, the segments are connected in sequence, i.e., the first segment is drawn from the point described in the Latitude and Longitude fields in the J3.0E0 word, to the point established by the Delta Latitude, 1 and Delta Longitude, 1 fields in the J3.0C1 word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This details the alternative flow for defining segmented lines (Descriptor = 2) versus multisided areas, specifying the connection logic for multiple points.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative successful path for reporting responsibility transfer via operator action when new information is available, diverging from the standard periodic update flow.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point, the unit with R² is declared inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative success scenario where reporting responsibility shifts to a different JU due to inactivity or timeout, requiring operator intervention to assume control.

evidence_cards.content: Upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report for a ballistic missile, the JU with R² of the Launch Point or Impact Point shall transmit the Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages with the Connect/Disconnect field set to value 1, Disconnect.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow path where a Drop Track Report triggers a specific disconnection message sequence while retaining reporting responsibility logic.

evidence_cards.content: Any subsequent reports of the Impact Point or Launch Point shall be transmitted with the Related 2 Track Number field Of the J3.0C5 message set to value 0, No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the data content constraint for reports following the initial disconnection in this alternative flow.

evidence_cards.content: If the originator of a J3.0 Ballistic Missile Launch Point retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point; however, if a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the condition under which the originator loses reporting responsibility (R²) via a Drop Track Report, triggering a potential hand-off.

evidence_cards.content: If no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another IU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point using the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the recovery mechanism (alternative flow) for assuming reporting responsibility when the original unit becomes inactive due to timeout.

evidence_cards.content: Point surveillance data is included in the J3.0 Reference Point message and the J3.1 Emergency Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies an alternative message type (J3.1) for reporting point surveillance data, which constitutes an alternative flow to the main J3.0 path.

evidence_cards.content: Land (Ground) surveillance data is included in the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific alternative message type (J3.5) for land-based surveillance data, representing a variant path for that specific geometry type.

evidence_cards.content: Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data is included in the J3.6 Space Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific alternative message type (J3.6) for space/ballistic missile data, representing a variant path for that specific geometry type.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a legal alternative path where the system successfully resolves a conflict between tracks from different units by retaining the external PPLI source and dropping the local track, rather than following the main flow of accepting the local track or reporting it.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an alternative successful flow for handling duplicate Track Numbers (TNs) where the unit accepts external PPLI data over local J3 data, diverging from standard independent processing.

evidence_cards.content: When the J3.0 message is used to report a point (as an alternative to lines or areas), the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field shall be set to value 0, Point, in the initial word.

source_locations.location: Page 4-159, paragraph beginning 'When the J3.0 message is used...'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific alternative flow path for reporting simple points instead of complex geometries, diverging from the main flow's multisided area descriptor setting.

evidence_cards.content: The capability is provided for the J3.0 message to transmit lines such as FEBAs and roads, and areas such as search areas and exercise areas, as alternatives to single points.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies valid alternative geometry types (lines and areas) supported by the J3.0 message, representing successful variants of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where a JU updates an existing emergency point with new information, diverging from the standard periodic update cycle.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point, the unit with R² is declared inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative path for reporting responsibility transfer (R² assumption) triggered by inactivity or explicit termination messages, allowing a different JU to continue reporting.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assuming R² for an emergency point shall use the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the data continuity constraints required during the alternative flow of assuming reporting responsibility for an emergency point.

evidence_cards.content: If the actual launcher is detected by sensors, a J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message shall be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative reporting flow for Ballistic Missile Launch Points when sensor detection of the actual launcher occurs, diverging from the standard J3.0 Reference Point report.

evidence_cards.content: If the actual launcher is associated with a launch point, it shall be associated using the J7.7 Association message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an additional step in the alternative flow to link the detected launcher entity to the reported launch point.

evidence_cards.content: Differences in ballistic missile position or velocity recognized by a JU are not resolved through conflict processing and shall not generate a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 1, Difference Report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative handling path where data differences exist but do not trigger the standard difference report mechanism (J7.0), implying the track is handled via other means (e.g., assumed as different tracks).

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 message... is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track for which it currently has R², except when a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an exception/alternative condition ('except when') to the standard termination reporting flow, defining when the Drop Track Report is suppressed during an R² handoff.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate an emergency or force tell alert on tracks by setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in the J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track, J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a valid alternative flow for alert initiation using specific track types (J3.2-J3.5) instead of the main flow's focus on geometric areas via J3.0.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall terminate an emergency or force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message terminating the alert and setting the appropriate EMG IND field or FT IND field in subsequent J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 messages to 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the termination mechanism for the alternative flow involving track alerts, diverging from the main flow which deals with area/line alerts.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R² for the Reference TN shall respond to a J7.1 message (Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request) by transmitting data held in the appropriate J3.6 Space Track word sequence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a successful alternative flow where the system responds to a specific request type (Ballistic Missile) using a different message format (J3.6) than the standard geometric area definition (J3.0), diverging from the main flow based on the request indicator value.

evidence_cards.content: NonR² JUs shall not respond to a J7.1 (ACT = 2) Ballistic Missile Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a condition-based divergence in the response path where units without reporting responsibility explicitly do not participate in this specific alternative flow.

evidence_cards.content: A Point Amplification value of No Statement may be changed to a non-No Statement value and retain the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a legal alternative path for modifying point attributes (Point Amplification) while retaining the identity (Reference TN), which is an exception to the general rule that changing point type/amplification is illegal.

evidence_cards.content: When defining an area that is a square or rectangle (Square/Circle Switch = 1), the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the J3.0I word shall be set to value 1, Single Point Area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific descriptor setting for square/rectangle areas as an alternative flow to the multisided area definition described in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When defining an area that is a circle or ellipse (Square/Circle Switch = 2), the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the J3.0I word shall be set to value 1, Single Point Area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific descriptor setting for circle/ellipse areas as an alternative flow to the multisided area definition described in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative path for reporting responsibility where any JU can update an emergency point if they have better data, diverging from the standard R² retention rules.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may assume R² for the point by operator action only.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific conditions and mechanism for transferring reporting responsibility for emergency points, serving as an alternative flow to the standard originator retention.
